mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_node_run ( workflow_run_id, workflow_version_id, workflow_node_id, node_key, node_type, sequence, status, input_summary, output_summary, agent_run_id, agent_run_step_id, tool_call_id, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{workflowRunId}, #{workflowVersionId}, #{workflowNodeId}, #{nodeKey}, #{nodeType}, #{sequence}, #{status}, #{inputSummary}, #{outputSummary}, #{agentRunId}, #{agentRunStepId}, #{toolCallId}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, workflow_run_id, workflow_version_id, workflow_node_id, node_key, node_type, sequence, status, input_summary, output_summary, agent_run_id, agent_run_step_id, tool_call_id, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, created_at, updated_at FROM workflow_node_run WHERE workflow_run_id = #{workflowRunId} ORDER BY sequence, id
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_node_run SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', output_summary = #{outputSummary}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE workflow_node_run SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE workflow_node_run SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE workflow_run_id = #{workflowRunId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_APPROVAL')
